model.name: Federation import wiring (end-to-end receive orchestration)
model.description: The receiver's end-to-end federation IMPORT endpoint (POST /api/federation/import) that ORCHESTRATES R26.1-R26.5 into one working receive: it takes a federated reference (R26.2), fetches the unit from the origin (R26.3), validates + recreates it locally with provenance (R26.1 originHost/originIor), resolves children per the eager-structure/lazy-payload policy (R26.4), and reconciles any uuid conflict (R26.5) — leaving the transferred unit present locally with intact unitLinks. Foreign identities are never minted as local principals; incoming JSON is validated, size-capped, sanitized, never executed.

discoverySource.note: R26.1-5 spec the capabilities + origin fetch API + import behaviours, but none names the RECEIVER end-to-end import orchestration endpoint /api/federation/import. Code shipped v0.7.7 BEFORE the req = #126 slip; chain completed retroactively.

model.crossRefNote: R26.6 COMPOSES R26.1-R26.5 (the integration/orchestration <<include>>): R26.2 ref -> R26.3 fetch -> R26.1 recreate+provenance -> R26.4 lazy children -> R26.5 reconcile. Not a duplicate — it is the end-to-end glue none of them names.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The receiver exposes POST /api/federation/import accepting a federated reference (or fetchUrl) and returning the imported unit's local IOR.

Import sequences: fetch unit JSON from origin (R26.3) -> validate -> recreate locally with provenance (R26.1 originHost/originIor) -> resolve children per eager/lazy policy (R26.4) -> reconcile uuid conflict (R26.5) -> link the chain.
Incoming JSON is validated (schema + size-cap + sanitize), NEVER executed; foreign identities never become local auth principals (per securityNote + R25.7 members-by-reference).
After import the transferred unit exists locally (recreated) with intact unitLinks + provenance, appearing in the target room/context.
Re-import of the same reference is safe - it delegates to the R26.5 reconcile (no blind duplicate).
R26.6 is the INTEGRATION that composes R26.1-R26.5 (<<include>>); the constituent capabilities live in those reqs.
